assistant_outcomes.text: You want VS Code to prefer your local Qwen Coder over Copilot. I'll check your VS Code settings and any local model setup first.
Settings look thin — no AI extension config yet. Checking Ollama/Qwen, other editors, and Mag provider config.
Continue + Ollama Qwen are present. Checking Continue config and what forces Copilot as default.
Diagnosis: VS Code Chat is on Copilot (needs credits); Continue is under Cursor, not VS Code; `chatLanguageModels.json` is broken (`"models": [...]`). Wiring local Qwen properly.
Fixing the broken model config and pointing VS Code at local Qwen; disabling Copilot so it stops eating the default.
Removing the fake comment key from settings so VS Code stays clean.

## What was wrong 1. **VS Code Chat was on Copilot** (cloud, credits). You have no credits, so it keeps failing / staying on Copilot. 2. **Your local Qwen setup was half-done:** - Continue was only under **Cursor**, not registered in **VS Code**. - `chatLanguageModels.json` was broken — literally `"models": [...]` (placeholder, not real models). 3. **Ollama is fine.** `qwen2.5-coder:7b` answers (`pong` smoke test passed). ## What I fixed | Change | Effect | |--------|--------| | Installed **Continue** + **Ollama** into VS Code | Local chat/autocomplete path that does not need Copilot | | Fixed
